content.comment_body: I have a [company_name] [product_name] [version_no] [article_no] programmed to save analog input data to its SD memory. Is it possible to access the SD card using the [product_name] and display historical data in Excel? I've installed the [product_name] Excel add-in, but when I attempt to connect to the device via IP address, Excel shows 'error 91 at run time.' I am using MS Office Professional Plus 2010.

Thread closed since the question was posted twice. The duplicate thread titled 'Is it possible to access the SD through the [product_name]' is available in the same conference section for [product_name] - Software. Best regards [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user experiences a runtime error ('error 91 at run time') when using the [product_name] Excel add-in to access historical data from a [product_name] device's SD card.
